units.title: Classification by Cell of Origin, Mature T-Cell Lymphomas (ALCL to Hepatosplenic) & Grade-Based Classification
units.sec: Classification by Cell of Origin, Mature T-Cell Lymphomas (ALCL to Hepatosplenic) & Grade-Based Classification
units.guide:
Cell of origin: Precursor T → T-ALL/LBL; Mature T → mature T-cell lymphoma; Precursor B → ALL; Pre-GC → MCL; Centroblasts → DLBCL, Burkitt's; Centrocytes → Follicular; Post-GC → MZL; Plasmablast → ABC-DLBCL.
Mature T-cell lymphomas: (1) ALCL — ALK (CD30)+, t(2;5), breast implants, hallmark cells; (2) Angioimmunoblastic; (3) Enteropathy/Celiac T-cell; (4) Mycosis fungoides/Sezary; (5) Extranodal NK/T (EBV+); (6) HTLV-1 adult T-cell; (7) Hepatosplenic.
Prognosis & grade: B-cell > T-cell; m/c NHL = DLBCL. Grade: Low (SLL, MZL, Follicular); Intermediate–high (MCL); High (DLBCL, Burkitt's).

units.title: Causative Organisms Table (EBV 100/70/40/20 Rule, HIV, HCV, H. pylori, HHV-8, HTLV-1) & Ann-Arbor Staging
units.sec: Causative Organisms Table (EBV 100/70/40/20 Rule, HIV, HCV, H. pylori, HHV-8, HTLV-1) & Ann-Arbor Staging
units.guide:
Organisms: EBV → Hodgkin 100/70/40/20 rule (LD 100%, MC 70%, NS 40%, LR 20%) & NHL (B-cell: Burkitt's, Post-transplant & Primary CNS [DLBCL morphology]; T-cell: Extranodal NK/T); HIV → DLBCL, Burkitt's; HCV → Waldenstrom's, Splenic MZL; H. pylori → MALToma; HHV-8 → Primary effusion lymphoma, Castleman's; HTLV-1 → Adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma.
Ann-Arbor staging: I (single LN region), II (≥2 LN regions same side of diaphragm), III (both sides of diaphragm), IV (diffuse extralymphatic: lung, liver, bone).
Risk grouping: Stages I–II = Early (Unfavourable if Age ≥60, ↑ LDH, >1 extranodal site, poor PS); Stages III–IV = Late/advanced (Unfavourable by default).

units.title: NHL General Features, Mantle Cell Lymphoma (t(11;14), SOX-11, R-CHOP Resistance) & Follicular Lymphoma Genetics
units.sec: NHL General Features, Mantle Cell Lymphoma (t(11;14), SOX-11, R-CHOP Resistance) & Follicular Lymphoma Genetics
units.guide:
General NHL features: Age 60 yrs, M > F, m/c asymptomatic painless lymphadenopathy, m/c nodal site = supraclavicular; extranodal = GIT (m/c), Waldeyer's ring, BM (30–40%); B-symptoms & CNS very rare.
Mantle cell lymphoma: Pre-GC origin; CD5+, Cyclin D1+, SOX-11+, t(11;14), CD10–, CD23–; aggressive (GIT lymphomatoid polyposis, BM, blood, spleen; unresponsive to R-CHOP); Classical = SOX-11+, Leukemic non-nodal = SOX-11– (printed good prognostic factor: SOX-11 upregulation).
Follicular lymphoma genetics: CD10+, CD23+ & BCL-6 dysregulation (all GC malignancies) + aberrant BCL-2 from t(14;18) (chr 14 IgG heavy chain [printed] + chr 18 BCL-2).

units.title: Follicular Lymphoma Histology/Course/Rx, Germinal Centre Malignancies Table & MALToma (t(11;18), H. pylori, Sjögren)
units.sec: Follicular Lymphoma Histology/Course/Rx, Germinal Centre Malignancies Table & MALToma (t(11;18), H. pylori, Sjögren)
units.guide:
Follicular lymphoma: Paratrabecular lymphoid aggregates with small cleaved + large non-cleaved cells; B-symptoms rare, spontaneous remission & relapse common; treat symptomatic only (low burden: Rituximab); Richter transformation 3%/yr. GC table: Centrocyte = Follicular (low grade); Centroblast = Burkitt's & DLBCL (aggressive).
MALToma: m/c MZL (purely extranodal), post-GC origin, F > M (autoimmune), H. pylori non-atrophic pan-gastritis in 95%; CD5–, CD10–, CD23–, t(11;18); upper GI symptoms.
MALToma Rx & notes: H. pylori eradication (80% respond) → R-CHOP trial if no response; printed good prognosis = H. pylori +ve, t(11;18); Richter conversion to DLBCL; Sjögren MZL involves salivary gland.

units.title: High-Grade Lymphomas Overview, Clinical Features & Prognostic Factors, and Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma (DLBCL)
units.sec: High-Grade Lymphomas Overview, Clinical Features & Prognostic Factors, and Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma (DLBCL)
units.guide:
High-grade lymphomas: (1) DLBCL, (2) Burkitt's, (3) Anaplastic large lymphoma [printed 'B-cell' on p150] — t(2;5), CD30+, hallmark & flower cells.
High-grade features: Rapidly progressive painless lymphadenopathy causing compression, extensive B-symptoms, extranodal (e.g., GIT), 'no involvement of BM or CNS' (general note), bad prognosis = LDH & hypoalbuminemia.
DLBCL overview: Age >60 yrs, M > F, aggressive, m/c NHL; primary nodal site = Neck; extranodal = mainly GIT.

units.title: DLBCL Subtypes (GCB vs ABC-DLBCL), Double/Triple-Hit vs Double-Expressor Venn Diagram & R-CHOP Regimen
units.sec: DLBCL Subtypes (GCB vs ABC-DLBCL), Double/Triple-Hit vs Double-Expressor Venn Diagram & R-CHOP Regimen
units.guide:
DLBCL subtypes: Germinal centre (CD10+, CD23+, BCL-6+; good prognosis) vs Activated B-cell / ABC-DLBCL (plasmablast origin; CD10–/BCL-6+/MUM-1+ or CD10–/BCL-6–; CNS, mediastinal, organ transplant & body cavity lymphomas = ABC-DLBCL unless proven otherwise; HIV-defining; bad prognosis).
Genetics & Venn diagram: Dysregulated BCL-6 > aberrant BCL-2 t(14;18) (opposite in follicular). Double hit (c-myc + BCL-2/BCL-6 rearrangements, GCB) & Triple hit (c-myc + BCL-2 + BCL-6) = bad prognosis; Double expressor (high MYC + BCL-2 protein, ABC).
Treatment: R-CHOP = Rituximab + Cyclophosphamide + Hydroxy-daunorubicin + Oncovirin (Vincristine) + Prednisolone.

units.title: DLBCL Interim-PET Flowchart & Burkitt's Lymphoma (c-myc Translocations, Endemic vs Sporadic, CODOX-M/IVAC, Starry Sky)
units.sec: DLBCL Interim-PET Flowchart & Burkitt's Lymphoma (c-myc Translocations, Endemic vs Sporadic, CODOX-M/IVAC, Starry Sky)
units.guide:
DLBCL response-adapted Rx: 2 cycles R-CHOP → Interim PET: Good score → +2 cycles R-CHOP (early favourable) or +4 cycles R-CHOP (early unfavourable); Advanced disease → Autologous stem cell transplant.
Burkitt's lymphoma: 30% of childhood NHL, CNS involvement, chemosensitive, CD10+ & BCL-6+; chr 8 c-myc translocations t(8;14) [m/c], t(8;2), t(8;22) → highest Ki67 among NHL.
Types, Rx & histology: Endemic (children, EBV+, jaw/maxillary mass), Sporadic (adult, EBV–, abdominal mass, BM >30%), HIV-associated. Rx: CODOX-M/IVAC (unresponsive to conventional chemo). BM involvement note: Burkitt's, MCL, DLBCL (20%). Starry sky: Stars = macrophages, Sky = tumor cells.
